diveTitle: What actually happens when you merge
diveSubtitle: How page order, bookmarks and metadata are handled.
dive1Title: What order will my pages come out in?
dive1Desc: Files merge in the exact order you arrange them before clicking merge — drag any file up or down in the list to reorder it. The page order inside each individual file stays untouched; only the order of the files themselves changes.
dive2Title: Merging PDFs with different page sizes
dive2Desc: A4, Letter, and custom page sizes can all be merged into one file without any resizing or cropping — each page keeps its original dimensions and orientation. The output simply contains pages of mixed sizes back to back, exactly like the sources.
dive3Desc: A PDF locked with an open password can't be merged until it's unlocked first, since we can't read pages we can't open. Run it through Unlock PDF, then merge — the merged file itself won't carry over the original password.
dive4Title: Merging scanned pages with digital documents
dive4Desc: There's no technical difference between merging a scanned page and a digitally created one — both are just pages in a PDF. The only thing that changes is searchability: text in digital pages stays selectable, while scanned pages stay as images unless you run OCR separately.
dive5Title: Does the merged file size just add up?
dive5Desc: Roughly, yes — the merged PDF is close to the sum of the source files, plus a small amount of overhead for the combined document structure. If the sources share embedded fonts or resources, the merged file can occasionally come out slightly smaller than the raw total.
dive6Title: What happens to bookmarks and metadata
dive6Desc: Each source file's internal bookmarks are preserved and nested under that file's section in the merged PDF, so navigation still works. Document metadata like title and author isn't merged automatically — the combined file inherits it from whichever source is set as the base.
faq1Question: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
faq1Answer: On the free plan you can merge up to 2 files at a time, up to 25 MB in total. Starter unlocks 10 files at once, up to 200 MB in total. Need more on the free plan? Merge in batches — combine 2, then merge that result with the next file.
faq2Question: Will the quality get worse when I combine them?
faq2Answer: Nope. Everything stays exactly as it was. Text looks the same, images are still sharp, formatting doesn't change. We just stick the files together without messing with the content.
faq3Question: Can I change the order before merging?
faq3Answer: Yes. After you upload, all your files appear in a list. Drag them into the order you want and the merged PDF follows it.
faq4Question: Is this safe to use with private documents?
faq4Answer: Everything is encrypted when you upload. We process files on secure servers and delete both your originals and the merged file after an hour. We do not read your documents.
faq5Question: Do I need to install anything?
faq5Answer: No. It runs in your browser on phone, tablet and computer.
